description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based network application implementing gPTP (generalized Precision Time Protocol) with VLAN support, including interface setup, VLAN initialization, and gPTP phase change callback handling.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback for processing network interfaces, assigns VLAN interfaces to user data structure.

methods.name: setup_iface
methods.description: Configures a network interface with IPv6, IPv4 addresses, and VLAN tagging.

methods.name: init_vlan
methods.description: Initializes VLAN interfaces and assigns IP addresses for testing.

methods.name: gptp_phase_dis_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked on gPTP phase change, logs the grandmaster identity and phase information.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes VLAN setup and registers gPTP phase change callback.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, calls initialization functions and testing setup.
